builds.name: Reference: Mana burn zones
builds.goal: Reference for Swain: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A sustained close-range mage who gains health from soul collection and keeps R active by draining champions. Roots and pulls create the proximity needed for repeated Q bolts and drain. Fix soul health and actual R drain contact. Tank AP must still maintain mana and threat; do not assign permanent infinite R if enemies leave drain range. Mana and repeated ability damage may maintain burns and MR-reduction stacks.
builds.summary: Mana and repeated ability damage may maintain burns and MR-reduction stacks.
testPlan: Kit question for Swain: Fix soul health and actual R drain contact. Tank AP must still maintain mana and threat; do not assign permanent infinite R if enemies leave drain range.

Start with the early core (Blackfire Torch, then Liandry) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Mana and repeated ability damage may maintain burns and MR-reduction stacks. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Swain unleashes several bolts of eldritch power that pierce through enemies. Enemies hit take more damage for each bolt they are struck by. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
